description: One-shot historical context for CI: given content (a diff, file path, symbol, commit subject, or feature name), return the most relevant default-branch commits, the associated mailing-list discussion (message links), and the tracked people involved (community page links). Read-only; composes git history + list search.

content.description: Free text: a diff/hunk, file path(s), symbol name, commit subject, feature name, or error text.

inbox.description: Mailing list to search for discussion (default: pgsql-hackers).

repo.description: Tracked repo whose default branch to trace (default: postgres).

name: history-of
